name: What should I prepare before contacting you for a door restoration quote?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting you for a door restoration quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us for a door restoration quote, it's helpful to gather some information. This includes details about the door's age, material, and a description of the damage. Taking a few clear photos of the door, especially close-ups of the damaged areas, can also be very useful. These preparations allow us to understand the scope of work more accurately and provide a more precise initial assessment and quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare door age, material, damage description, and clear photos to help us provide an accurate restoration quote.
